baseline.scope_note: The baseline is recorded for audit; feature states below are derived from this checkout and are not claims of runtime integration.

systems.owner: Arena Foundry qualification and World-operation tool
systems.player_loop: Not directly player-facing; safely apply, retry, audit, and roll back a generated World-content package.
outstanding_tests: Exercise full pinned AzerothCore World initialization/base rows and test foreign collisions against populated disposable data (current qualifier deliberately requires empty schema)
Add supported MariaDB/server-version matrix and independent backup/restore proof before any non-empty DB workflow
risks: Legacy World SQL qualification remains fail-closed
Only InnoDB is supported; MySQL DDL bootstrap is separate from transactional DML
Changed manifests/versions are refused rather than upgraded
Never use against production or populated shared DBs
systems.next_milestone: Integrate the qualifier with full pinned World base data on a disposable restored DB and prove foreign-row collisions; keep the gate scoped to synthetic fixtures until that populated-data acceptance is passed. Portable Hole now builds on the tested receipt/reservation contract.

completed_evidence.scope: MySQL 8.4 disposable InnoDB item_template fixture; apply/retry/rollback/reapply, partial collision rollback, client connection loss/retry, ownership/manifest checks, full-row modification refusal, concurrency, engine/primary-key guards and caller-transaction refusal

MySQL 8.4 fresh empty disposable DB; seven pinned generated-table DDL sources hashed and initialized, runtime InnoDB engines/PKs checked; abrupt worker death after item INSERT, transaction/journal/receipt absence, same-request restart apply/replay and owned rollback verified. Not all generated tables' writes; no base rows imported.

MySQL 8.4 all seven supported generated tables: exact-pinned DDL, late foreign collision atomic rollback, changed-row rollback refusal, process death after npc_vendor INSERT with multiple uncommitted tables, same-request restart/replay, v3 source/schema/code/receipt attestation; foundry qualify World DB gate PASS for the synthetic fixture only; package release remained BLOCKED. No base rows imported.
